rule: One block per session, fresh context each time. Driven by scripts/overhaul-loop.sh, which owns this file -- block agents must not edit it. Blocks commit and push directly to master; no PRs.
handoffNotes: docs/plans/overhaul/notes/block-<id>.md, written by each block for the next one

blocks.title: Local dev unblock
blocks.doneWhen: ./run.sh starts the dev server with no MariaDB, MinIO or Redis running
blocks.notes: Also carries PR #1's serial hardening (077b260, 6396b2e). Blocks 2 and 4 replace that work properly; leave it in place until they do.

blocks.title: Verification harness
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify exits 0; CI runs it on push and PR
blocks.notes: vitest + fast-check, packages/am32-core skeleton with DOM/Node-free tsconfig, lint baseline to 0 errors, CLAUDE.md, this file, /block skill, the assert-* gates and the driver loop.

blocks.title: Delete removed features
blocks.notes: Bootloader flashing (.amj tab, AmjType), USB-direct mode (src/communication/direct.ts and its guards), bootloader downloads. Mechanical, no protocol work. Bootloader info display in EscView stays.

blocks.title: Protocol core extraction
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify with the eeprom round-trip property test, MSP v1/v2/error/echo golden vectors and 4-way framing vectors all green
blocks.notes: EEPROM_SIZE 192, CAN_SETTINGS as Uint8Array, encode from the read-back buffer. Reimplement MSP framing from the firmware sources -- do NOT port @am32/serial-msp's compiled dist. Fixes audit A (codec half) and D.

blocks.title: Link and transports
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify, plus a test proving two concurrent request() calls serialise, plus assert-core-hygiene
blocks.notes: Transport, Link, injectable Clock, drain semantics, retry, TimeoutPolicy. packages/am32-web replaces webserial-wrapper. Fixes E, G (hang + double drain), C.

blocks.title: Simulated FC and ESCs
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify, plus every fault knob implemented and referenced by a test
blocks.notes: packages/am32-sim: SimEsc, SimFc (ArduPilot + Betaflight profiles), SimTransport, the fault knobs, virtual clock. Fidelity comes from the firmware sources -- read them with subagents. Previous run never started: the 5-hour session limit was exhausted by block 2 at 23:42 on 2026-07-28 and all three attempts hit it instantly.

blocks.title: Session API
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify, plus simulated 4-ESC ArduPilot enumerate, partial-failure enumerate that does not throw, and a Betaflight connect that skips the 4 s wait
blocks.hardwareCheckpoint: outstanding -- enumerate on a real ARK FPV and a Betaflight board. Cannot run unattended; record it, do not block on it.
blocks.notes: Am32Session + FC quirk modules. Fixes B and H. First attempt ran 18 minutes then hit the 5-hour session limit mid-run; attempts 2-3 hit it instantly. No code failure -- yarn verify was green (233 tests).

blocks.title: UI as a thin client
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify with the no-restricted-imports rule active, plus assert-deleted
blocks.notes: SerialDevice.vue shrinks to UI + store mirroring. Deletes src/communication/*, commands.queue.ts, the queue dependency, dead store fields (I). Flash failures surface as a toast and release the modal.

blocks.title: Verified settings write and flash
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify, plus a test proving a settings write leaves bytes 13-16 and 176-183 unchanged, and a flash with esc[n].slowBy(600) still succeeding
blocks.hardwareCheckpoint: outstanding -- settings round-trip across a power cycle with the CAN block intact, plus a local .hex flash.
blocks.notes: writeSettings with read-back verification, flash() with page handling, applyDefaults. Completes A and C. Drops the bootloader-version auto-write in getInfo.

blocks.title: Headless CLI
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify, plus `ark32 --sim enumerate --escs 4` and `ark32 --sim write --esc all -i fixture.bin` succeeding with no hardware
blocks.notes: packages/am32-node + packages/am32-cli including --sim. Packaging per issue #3 section 6.

blocks.title: ARK32 firmware catalog
blocks.doneWhen: A deploy with no MinIO shows the ARK32 release list and flashing from the catalog works end to end
blocks.notes: Out of the sequential path and never auto-run: there are no releases or tags to fetch until ARK32#67 lands.
